data.name: LoadFailedStatus
data.comment: Why tarkov.dev's data didn't load: the first sentence of the "No game data" notice and status line ("No game data. … "), and of the notice that a language's texts couldn't be loaded; an advice sentence (LoadAdvice…) follows it. {status}: the HTTP status code tarkov.dev answered, 503.

data.name: LoadFailedUnreachable
data.value: Couldn't reach tarkov.dev, and there's no saved copy yet.
data.comment: Why tarkov.dev's data didn't load: the first sentence of the "No game data" notice and status line ("No game data. … "), and of the notice that a language's texts couldn't be loaded; an advice sentence (LoadAdvice…) follows it. No connection to tarkov.dev, and no copy of the data saved on this PC.

data.name: LoadFailedTimedOut
data.value: tarkov.dev didn't answer in time, and there's no saved copy yet.
data.comment: Why tarkov.dev's data didn't load: the first sentence of the "No game data" notice and status line ("No game data. … "), and of the notice that a language's texts couldn't be loaded; an advice sentence (LoadAdvice…) follows it.

data.name: LoadFailedUnreadable
data.value: tarkov.dev's data has changed in a way Shturmap can't read.
data.comment: Why tarkov.dev's data didn't load: the first sentence of the "No game data" notice and status line ("No game data. … "), and of the notice that a language's texts couldn't be loaded; an advice sentence (LoadAdvice…) follows it. The data arrived, but in a format Shturmap doesn't know.

data.name: LoadFailedNotData
data.value: tarkov.dev's answer wasn't its data: a sign-in page or a filter in between?
data.comment: Why tarkov.dev's data didn't load: the first sentence of the "No game data" notice and status line ("No game data. … "), and of the notice that a language's texts couldn't be loaded; an advice sentence (LoadAdvice…) follows it. Something between the PC and tarkov.dev (a network's sign-in page, a filter) answered in its place.

data.name: LoadFailedDisk
data.value: Couldn't save tarkov.dev's data on this PC.
data.comment: Why tarkov.dev's data didn't load: the first sentence of the "No game data" notice and status line ("No game data. … "), and of the notice that a language's texts couldn't be loaded; an advice sentence (LoadAdvice…) follows it.

data.name: LoadFailedUnknown
data.comment: Why tarkov.dev's data didn't load: the first sentence of the "No game data" notice and status line ("No game data. … "), and of the notice that a language's texts couldn't be loaded; an advice sentence (LoadAdvice…) follows it. For a failure of no known kind.

data.name: LoadAdviceReport
data.comment: What to do about a load that failed: the sentence after the LoadFailed… one in the "No game data" notice and status line. For a failure only a report can get fixed; the notice offers the Report dialog.

data.name: LoadAdviceServerBusy
data.value: It is busy or down for a moment; try again in a few minutes.
data.comment: What to do about a load that failed: the sentence after the LoadFailed… one in the "No game data" notice and status line. After tarkov.dev answered 5xx or 429 (LoadFailedStatus).

data.name: LoadAdviceConnection
data.comment: What to do about a load that failed: the sentence after the LoadFailed… one in the "No game data" notice and status line.

data.name: LoadAdviceDisk
data.value: Check the free disk space and that %LOCALAPPDATA%\Shturmap can be written to.
data.comment: What to do about a load that failed: the sentence after the LoadFailed… one in the "No game data" notice and status line. %LOCALAPPDATA%\Shturmap is Shturmap's data folder: keep it as it is.

data.name: LoadAdviceNotData
data.value: Shturmap tries again in a few minutes.
data.comment: What to do about a load that failed: the sentence after the LoadFailed… one in the "No game data" notice and status line. After LoadFailedNotData: Shturmap asks again by itself.

data.name: RetryWaitMinutes
data.comment: How long until Shturmap asks tarkov.dev again, in notices: "Shturmap tries again in 2 minutes." {minutes}: whole minutes, 2 to 30.

data.name: RetryWaitSeconds
data.comment: As RetryWaitMinutes, for a wait shorter than a minute (only in tests and developer runs). {seconds}: whole seconds.

data.name: ItemUnknown
data.comment: In place of an item's name wherever one shows (item cards, what to bring) when tarkov.dev's data doesn't know the item.
